title: Sanger Sequencing Protocol
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8fghtjw

steps.title: Label Tubes
steps.instruction: Label 1.5 mL tubes using the barcodes provided by the sequencing company.

steps.title: Prepare Sequencing Reaction
steps.instruction: Add template, primer, and water to each tube to reach a total volume of 10.0 uL.

substeps.instruction: Add water to reach a total volume of 10.0 uL

steps.title: Submit Samples
steps.instruction: Place the prepared tubes inside a small plastic bag and deposit them in the sequencing company collection box.
